data.name: Nuwaisir
data.gender_notes: Nuwaisir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Nawi' which means 'gentle' and the suffix 'asir' which means 'chained' or 'warrior'. In Islamic history, Nuwaisir refers to a righteous and brave warrior who was renowned for his strength and unwavering commitment to truth and justice. The name Nuwaisir carries the meaning “Fierce, Brave Warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuwaisir usually hope their child will grow to embody fierce, brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
